relations.subject: Justus Olshausen
relations.evidence: Paris, where he was a student of Silvestre de Sacy (1758–1838).

relations.subject: Justus Olshausen
relations.evidence: From 1830 to 1852 he was a professor at the University of Kiel, where he was appointed curator in 1848.

relations.subject: Justus Olshausen
relations.evidence: In 1852 he was removed from his position at Kiel by the Danish government, which he had energetically opposed, and subsequently became a professor of Oriental languages at the University of Königsberg.

relations.subject: Justus Olshausen
relations.evidence: In 1860, he became a full member of the Prussian Academy of Sciences

relations.subject: Justus Olshausen
relations.evidence: in 1874 was appointed counselor to the Ministry of Education in Berlin.
